items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And this band then came before the other T-Boy Ramey. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh yeah. That's 28.

ctx.x: Only spots nights, you know. When the other bands wouldn't be there that they had. Because at that time I think Walter Pichon was playing up there. And sometimes we played with other bands. Two bands. Yeah. Contests.
And this band then came before the other T-Boy Ramey.
